comment: Day 3, third frozen holdout — the set the adjacency-expansion candidate is scored on. Sets #1 (cases_day3.json) and #2 (cases_day3b.json) are both spent. Set #3 is deliberately BALANCED rather than aimed at one class: set #2 was 7/12 boundary-straddling and could not tell the two ranking legs apart, because on 10 of 12 cases every arm scored zero. This set carries 3 cross-border cases (where expansion should help) and 9 across the other classes (where it must not hurt). No `dev` split: the candidate has no tuned parameter — it takes the neighbour of a selected window when it fits, full stop. No case or span is shared with sets #1 or #2.
